5. (Currently Amended) Use of the composition of claim 1 for preparation of a blocking vaccine to __impede__ Leishmaniasis transmission in __humans or dogs__.

6. (Currently Amended) The method of claim 4 wherein said composition further comprises suitable pharmacological vehicles for blocking Leishmaniasis transmission in __humans or dogs__.

7. (Currently Amended) The method of claim 4 wherein the Leishmania promastigotes or Leishmania amastigotes fractions called "Fucose Mannose Ligand" (FML) comprise a glycoprotein complex containing 29% of neutral sugar, 44% of protein, 11% of phosphate and hexosamines, traces composed by protein bands with molecular weight ranging from 9 to 95 kDa, some protein bands having carbohydrates: 36 and 54 to 68 kDa, the FML glycidic portion presenting 10% of fucose and 47% of mannose, 30% of glucose, 12% of galactose and xylose traces, amino acids containing 10 to 20% of glutamic acid, alanine, aspartic acid and glycine, 5 to 10% of serine, histidine, lysine, leucine, threonine, proline and valine, and 2 to 5% of arginine, methionine, isoleucine, tyrosine and phenylalanine, and that is __demonstrated to provide an immune response in humans or dogs__.
